g.text: Read the frames by what they hold.
The only credential material in a team namespace is the
workload's own identity (its leaf certificate) and the public CA bundle. Everything with spending
power lives in kaalm-system and crosses exactly one hop, in red, on the gateway's upstream leg.
Identity is what unlocks policy: grants, budgets, rate limits, and the audit record all key off the
verified SAN, or, in the gateway-only tier, off the TokenReview namespace, which is why that tier
gets namespace-level features only. The ABI factories exist so a framework presents this identity,
and follows its rotation, with zero handler code.
